description: Change a step's type or config in place, leaving its connections alone (move it with reorder_workflow_steps). Only stores the change. Config shapes are as in add_workflow_step.

checklist_id.description: Checklist to run, from the same workspace.

use_deployment_url.description: Run against the deployment URL from the triggering event instead of the checklist URL.

anyOf.description: Config for condition. Continues down its true branch when it holds.

value.description: Value the field is compared with.

anyOf.description: Config for notification: sends an email or Slack message to workspace members.

body.description: Message body for the custom template.

recipients.description: Email recipients. Defaults to every workspace member.

slack_channel_id.description: Slack channel for a Slack message.

subject.description: Email subject for the custom template.

template.description: Message template. 'custom' uses subject and body.

anyOf.description: Config for github_comment: comments on the triggering pull request.
Config for actor_pr_review: an actor reviews the triggering pull request.

actor_id.description: Actor that reviews, from the same workspace.

review_focus.description: What the review should concentrate on.

anyOf.description: Config for crawl_topology: crawls the topology again to make a new version.

topology_id.description: Topology to crawl, from the same workspace.

config.description: Replaces the step config in full: the shape matching the step type. Send every key the step needs, not a patch. Omit to keep the current config.

step_id.description: Workflow step UUID, from the `steps` array of get_workflow or the `id` returned by add_workflow_step.

step_type.description: New step type (run_checklist, condition, notification, delay, github_comment, actor_pr_review, crawl_topology). Omit to keep it. When changing type, also pass a config valid for the new type.
